name: dozing-roll
description: Normal range of head movement, and the head rolls 15° to the right during a 60-second doze every 8 minutes.
notes: Only dozing is on. Turn 25° left and right and 12° up and down are the awake default for 'normal range' (TUNE); the turn stays above 10°, so the profile does not count as small range. Doze every 8 min for 60 s with a 15° roll: given ('every 8 minutes the patient nods off for 60 seconds: the head rolls 15° to one side, then comes back'); dropDeg holds the size of the roll. Side: right, chosen here, because the description says only 'one side' and the format allows one dozing direction per profile. With the design's roll coupling (about 4.8 Board_Units to the right and 1.9 up per degree of right roll at 1280×800, TUNE), a right roll crosses NO (about 3.3° to 7.5° of roll) and then CAN'T BREATHE (about 9.6° to 13°) on every Level (design.md, 'Waking and a head held rolled'); by the same figures it parks at 15° near (152, 22), past CAN'T BREATHE's right edge at x 144. Every doze therefore crosses an urgent target on the way out and on the way back, so the Rest_Runs test that a roll across one fires nothing (SAF-3). A left roll moves the pointer down, away from the urgent targets, which all sit above the rest zone (SAF-7); left rolls and head drops are tested by the SAF-3 generators (Requirement 9.5, task 11.6). Roll speed is set by the simulator, not by this file: the design assumes a fast roll (10° or more within 500 ms, TUNE), so the roll guard acts first, and because 15° is above the 10° held-roll threshold (TUNE), the held-roll pause holds from 2 s into each doze until the head comes back. Timing, an assumption the simulator must keep: the first doze starts at minute 8, not at minute 0, so every run starts with the head at neutral, and the dozes repeat exactly every 8 minutes, with no jitter and no seed-based offset, so they run 8:00–9:00, 16:00–17:00, 24:00–25:00 and so on. A 10-minute run (the Active_Use_Run, 0:00 to 10:00) then holds one full doze, 8:00 to 9:00. A 60-minute Rest_Run holds 7 full dozes, the first at 8:00 and the last from 56:00 to 57:00. Because 8 min plus 60 s is under 10 min, every 10-minute window from time 0 on holds at least one full doze under this timing. Tremor 0 at 0 Hz: 'no tremor' (given). Drift 0: 'no drift' (given), so not the 0.5° per minute default. Fatigue 0: 'no fatigue' (given). Face loss null: 'the face stays in view' (given). Seed 3705, given for task 3.7. All values stay TUNE until there are volunteer recordings (tech.md).
